Kill a [[Vengeful Aatxe]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill a [[Vengeful Aatxe]] in [[the Underworld]].
* *BONUS* Kill a Vengeful Aatxe in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Vengeful Aatxe are impervious to virtually all forms of damage and cannot be targeted by skills or attacks, but are killed automatically upon the death of their [[Keeper of Souls]]. As such, for practical purposes, the quest calls for the killing of a Keeper of Souls.

See [[Unwanted Guests]] for a walkthrough of the quest.

It is possible, but tedious and difficult, to kill one through a combination of [[life stealing]]. See [[Invulnerability]] for more information.
